SRI LANKA EXPORT DEVELOPMENT ACT, No. 40 OF 1979
Order under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979,I, Ranil Wickremesinghe, Minister of Investment Promotion with the concurrence of the Minister of Finance, Economic Stabilization and National Policies, do by this Order;

I. Impose the rate of CESS Levy speciﬁ ed in the Column IV in the Schedule hereto in respect of the items/goods described under the H.S Codes as speciﬁ ed in the Column II and III in the said schedule at the time of importation of such items/goods with effect from September 06, 2024.

And the Order made under Section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979 and published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notiﬁ cation No. 2336/71 dated June 16, 2023 is hereby rescinded with effect from September 06, 2024.

II. Pursuant to the decision of the Cabinet of Ministers dated August 12, 2024 on the Memorandum No. 24/0105/622/002, read together with the Notes to the Cabinet dated May 21, 2024 and July 29, 2024 titled “Providing an opportunity to Sri Lanka to enhance foreign exchange earnings and improve living conditions of quarry workers and associated communities through export of rock boulders, subject to restrictive conditions”, there shall be charged and collect a CESS levy at the rate of Rs. 1000/- per cubic meter (m3) on export up to one million metric tons of rock boulders [Boulders exported for construction purposes (Charnockite and Gneisses)], classiﬁ able under the HS Code of 2516.11.00, on the recommendation of the Secretary to the Ministry in charge of subject of Environment effective from September 06, 2024. For all other export of Granite, classiﬁ able under the HS Code of 2516.11.00, the CESS Levy shall be charged and collected at rates speciﬁ ed in the Gazette No. 2210/09 dated January 12, 2021.
RANIL WICKREMESINGHE, Minister of Investment Promotion.
Ministry of Investment Promotion,05th September, 2024.
